summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Woodside Energy Group Ltd, a foreign private issuer, reporting an Appendix 3Y and Appendix 3G to the ASX. The Appendix 3Y discloses a change in director's (Liz Westcott) relevant interests in securities, specifically the allocation of 119,926 performance rights at an estimated A$24.05 per share, as approved at the company's AGM. This is a standard director share compensation disclosure, not a special situation corporate event. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change event is involved.
